subject: 🤖 Nous Hermes Agent Lives in Teams Now, MIT Licensed
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Sponsor blocks (incident.io, Google Cloud TPUs, Chalk) and event promos ignored.

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens
stories.quote: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon with 1M context at $3 per million tokens
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon model, between Google's mid-tier and top-tier models

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon price list: $3 per million input tokens, $15 per million output tokens
facts.quote: Pricing is $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output. You can hit it right now via the Gemini API or AI Studio using model ID

facts.text: Stated as 32% cheaper per task than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default setting (measurer not named)
facts.quote: than Gemini 4 Carbon at the default setting

facts.text: Four thinking levels to trade cost against intelligence per task
facts.quote: Four thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh), letting you dial cost vs. intelligence per task

stories.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 to the API with standby mode priced at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05
stories.quote: OpenAI ships GPT-Live-1.1 to API with standby mode cutting idle costs 60%
stories.description: GPT-Live-1.1 voice model in the API

facts.text: Standby mode keeps an idle call open at $0.02 per minute
Usual rate is $0.05 per minute; standby is a 60% drop in idle costs
facts.quote: instead of the usual $0.05. That's a 60% drop in idle costs.

facts.text: Silence timeout can be set between 5 and 60 seconds
facts.quote: Set a silence timeout between 5 and 60 seconds.

facts.text: Standby applies to both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1
facts.quote: Standby works on both GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1.1

stories.headline: Nous Research releases Hermes Enterprise, bringing its Hermes agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure
stories.quote: Nous Research brings its Hermes agent to Microsoft Teams and Azure
stories.description: Maker of the open-source Hermes AI agent

facts.text: Agent tasks run in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes
Can be deployed inside the customer's own Azure tenant
facts.quote: Deploy the whole thing inside your own Azure tenant if your company has strict data rules
and open-source, so you can inspect exactly what it does.
